scientific_intent.scientific_task: MRI nonuniform k-space Q structure for convolution-based Hessian multiplication
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Compute squared complex Fourier basis magnitude, then weighted direct complex Fourier sum for each spatial sample.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Building block for MRI reconstruction with arbitrary k-space trajectories; no complete reconstruction or diagnostic image certificate.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Independent Float64 direct Fourier oracle using actual Float32 coordinates/basis; all outputs/intermediate Phi, analytic controls and guards.
